name: Loamwork
tagline: Know your dirt before you plant a dime into it.
positioning: Loamwork turns lab results and field samples into plain-language soil reports SMB growers can actually act on — no agronomy degree required.

hero.h1: Soil reports that read like advice, not chemistry homework.
hero.sub: Loamwork ingests your lab panels and field samples, then hands back a clear plan: what to amend, how much, and when. Built for the owner who's also the operator.

features.title: Lab panels, decoded
features.description: Upload a PDF from any soil lab and Loamwork translates pH, CEC, and nutrient ratios into a ranked to-do list for each field or bed.

features.title: Amendment math, done
features.description: Tell us your acreage and target crop. We calculate exact lime, compost, and fertilizer amounts so you stop guessing and over-buying.

features.title: Season-over-season memory
features.description: Every sample is pinned to a map location, so you can watch organic matter climb and salinity drop across the years — not just this week.

features.title: Pin every sample
features.description: Drop georeferenced points as you walk the field. Loamwork ties each test back to the exact spot the shovel went in.

features.title: Reorder reminders
features.description: Get a nudge when it's time to re-sample a block or reapply an amendment, timed to your planting calendar.

features.title: Share with your crew
features.description: Send a clean, jargon-light report to a landlord, lender, or new hire — no login gymnastics required.

testimonials.quote: I used to shove lab PDFs in a drawer and hope for the best. Now I get a plain list telling me exactly how much lime block 4 needs. Loamwork paid for itself in fertilizer I didn't buy.
testimonials.name: Dana Reyes

testimonials.quote: We manage twelve leased fields for different landlords. Being able to pull a five-year organic matter chart per field has made our renewal conversations shockingly easy.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feldt

testimonials.quote: I'm a vineyard of one. Loamwork feels like having an agronomist who actually remembers what my soil did last spring, without the day rate.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For the solo operator managing a handful of fields.
For growing teams juggling multiple blocks and crews.
For co-ops and managers overseeing many farms.

homepage.footerBlurb: Loamwork helps small growers read their soil and act on it — one clear report at a time. Made for people with dirt on their boots.
